```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
```

## Results

Four floats, covering the four cases that have to be verified
together: a rotated table with a generated note, a rotated table with an
explicit chunk note, a rotated table with NO note at all, and a non-rotated
table with a generated note. `apatablelandscapenote.lua` (bundled) must move
the note inside the landscape section for the first two, leave the third
alone (nothing to move), and never touch the fourth (no landscape closer at
all).

`tbl-a`: rotated, generated note.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-a
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(mtcars))
```

`tbl-b`: rotated, explicit chunk `apa-note`.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-b
#| apa-note: "Explicit chunk note text for table B."
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(mtcars))
```

`tbl-c`: rotated, NO note at all (`note = ""` defeats the generated default
without a chunk `apa-note` taking its place -- see `apa_note_attr()`'s own
comment on an empty candidate).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-c
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(mtcars), note = "")
```

`tbl-d`: NOT rotated, generated note.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-d
#| echo: false
apaTables:::apa_quarto_markdown_block(apa.cor.table(attitude[, 1:3]))
```

ENDMARKER closes the body of this manuscript, after every table.
